headline: Govt plans to privatise power distribution and petroleum imports
summary: Energy Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud says the move aims to reduce the government's heavy subsidy burden in the energy sector.
details: The government is planning to allow the private sector to import petroleum products and privatise power distribution to reduce the subsidy burden.
Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud announced these plans during a discussion on energy security organised by Bonik Barta at the Pan Pacific Sonargaon Dhaka.
Currently, the government imports and produces energy and electricity at higher costs but sells them at lower prices to the consumers.
This price gap has significantly increased the financial burden of subsidies in the energy sector, prompting the government to seek private sector involvement.
caption:
The government is moving toward privatising power distribution and petroleum imports to cut costs.

The government is planning to allow the private sector to import petroleum products and privatise power distribution to reduce the subsidy burden.

Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Iqbal Hasan Mahmud announced these plans during a discussion on energy security organised by Bonik Barta at the Pan Pacific Sonargaon Dhaka.

Currently, the government imports and produces energy and electricity at higher costs but sells them at lower prices to the consumers.

This price gap has significantly increased the financial burden of subsidies in the energy sector, prompting the government to seek private sector involvement.

headline_marked: Fuel shortage rumors spark [[rush at petrol pumps in Rajshahi]]
headline: Fuel shortage rumors spark rush at petrol pumps in Rajshahi
summary: Panic buying ensues as residents rush to fill up their tanks following unverified reports of a fuel crisis.
details: A sudden rush of vehicles has been observed at several petrol pumps across Rajshahi city, triggered by rumors of an impending fuel shortage.
Panic-stricken residents have flocked to filling stations to secure fuel, leading to long queues and congestion on the city's roads.
The situation has caused significant disruption to daily transport and traffic flow as drivers compete to fill their tanks.
Authorities have urged the public to remain calm and avoid acting on unverified rumors that create artificial crises.
caption:
Panic in Rajshahi! Residents are rushing to petrol pumps following rumors of a fuel shortage.

A sudden rush of vehicles has been observed at several petrol pumps across Rajshahi city, triggered by rumors of an impending fuel shortage.

Panic-stricken residents have flocked to filling stations to secure fuel, leading to long queues and congestion on the city's roads.

The situation has caused significant disruption to daily transport and traffic flow as drivers compete to fill their tanks.

Authorities have urged the public to remain calm and avoid acting on unverified rumors that create artificial crises.
